sources.title: pavolia_reine_(1st_costume)
sources.excerpt:
The default costume of [[hololive Indonesia|hololive ID]]'s [[Pavolia Reine]]. 
 
It consists of a [[long dress|long]] [[sleeveless dress|sleeveless]] [[blue dress|blue]] with a [[high-low dress]], a [[skin tight]] section on the chest and a [[stomach cutout]], [[white sleeves|white]] [[see-through sleeves|see-through]] [[detached sleeves]], [[white thighhighs]] and [[gold shoes|gold]] [[high heels]].
